enabledHelp: Lets eligible users sign in with the provider. It matches existing Jellyfin Users by username and verified email from the provider.
publicUrlHelp: Leave empty to use the browser address. Set this when Jellyfin is behind a reverse proxy or has more than one public address.
issuerUrlHelp: The provider's OpenID Connect issuer URL.
clientIdHelp: The client ID registered with the provider.
clientSecretHelp: The secret for this client ID.
userGroupHelp: List provider groups, separated by commas. Members can sign in and get a Jellyfin User if needed.
administratorGroupHelp: List provider groups, separated by commas. Members can sign in as Jellyfin administrators.
groupClaimHelp: Use a top-level claim that contains a string or an array of strings. Configure nested claims at the provider.
additionalScopesHelp: List scopes separated by spaces. The plugin also requests openid email profile. For example, Authelia needs groups to return group membership.
loginButtonTextHelp: The text shown on the Jellyfin login page.
passwordLoginModeHelp: Choose whether Jellyfin Users can also sign in with local passwords.
synchronizeProfileImagesHelp: Update a Jellyfin User's profile image when they sign in, using the provider's picture claim.
rpInitiatedLogoutHelp: Also sign out at the provider. Add <Public Jellyfin URL>/web/index.html to its post-logout redirect URIs.
redirectSignInPageToProviderHelp: Send the Jellyfin sign-in page directly to the provider. When disabled, only the OIDC sign-in button is shown.
groupValidation: Enter a User Group, an Administrator Group, or both.
localPasswordWarning: Local password sign-in will be disabled for {0}. Verify OIDC sign-in is working before saving.
firstSignInMatchingHelp: Applies only to identities without an Identity Link. Preferred usernames must be unique and non-reassignable at the Identity Provider, or an identity could claim an existing Jellyfin User. Use explicit linking when that cannot be guaranteed.
openEnrollmentHelp: Leaving both group lists empty allows anyone authenticated by this Identity Provider to obtain a non-administrator Jellyfin User, even without group claims. With a public provider such as Google, this can mean anyone with a Google identity.
selfServiceHelp: Let signed-in Jellyfin Users link and unlink their own Identity Provider identity. Turning this off leaves read-only status, administrator management, and ordinary OIDC sign-in available.
providerBrandHelp: Presentation only. Select the Identity Provider explicitly; discovery does not provide a brand. Logos are served locally. Other uses SSO and a key icon.
identityUnlinkHelp: OIDC will stop opening this Jellyfin User until they explicitly link again or an administrator restores access. Existing Jellyfin and Identity Provider sessions remain active.
identityPasswordRecovery: Local password policy will be reapplied immediately. You still need a known local password to use it; a random provisioned password cannot be recovered.
identityAdminLockout: All local passwords are disabled. Unlinking may lock this Jellyfin User out until an administrator restores an Identity Link.
identityUnlinkDisabled: Self-service unlink is unavailable while all local passwords are disabled. Ask an administrator to restore access.
identityExpectedRequired: Enter an expected identity, or use Cancel pending match to remove an existing directive.
identityPendingHelp: This single-use match reserves the Jellyfin User until used or cancelled. Email must be verified. Preferred usernames must be unique and non-reassignable at the Identity Provider. The matching claim is not a permanent alias.
identityPendingConfirm: Reserve Jellyfin User {0} for {1}: {2}? This value will be consumed by one eligible sign-in.
identityOptOutHelp: An explicit unlink reserves this Jellyfin User. Access can be restored only by explicitly relinking the same identity or a successful administrator-directed match to this user.
identityAdminConfirm: Link Identity Provider identity {0} to Jellyfin User {1}? Verify this is the intended identity. Your current Jellyfin session will be preserved.
identityLinkedSuccess: Identity Provider linked. Your current Jellyfin session is unchanged.
identityUnlinkedSuccess: Identity Provider unlinked. Automatic matching and provisioning for this identity are blocked.
identityPendingSuccess: Pending match saved. The next eligible sign-in will consume it and create an Identity Link.
identityPendingCancelled: Pending match cancelled. Existing unlink opt-outs remain in place.
identityLinkCancelled: Linking cancelled. No Identity Link was created.
identityLinkFailed: The linking attempt failed or was cancelled. No Identity Link was created. Try again from this page.
identityConflict: Identity state changed or could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
identitySessionExpired: Your Jellyfin session expired or this action is not permitted. Sign in again or ask an administrator.
identityPartialSuccess: The Jellyfin User was created, but its pending OIDC match could not be saved. Enter the expected identity here and retry.
